An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<a href="https://example.com/outer"><table><tr><td><a href="https://example.com/inner">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>"#;
    let options: ConversionOptions = Default::default();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
